correlation_steps_to_scripts.test_step: Reset HPX application to default state and ensure user is logged in before launching.
Add supported printer device via 'Add Device' button on root view screen, searching by IP address, and verify printer is listed and ready.

After each navigation (root view, device details, shortcuts screen, add new shortcuts screen), assert that the expected screen title and main UI elements are visible and correctly rendered for early failure detection.

intermediary_steps.test_case_step: Reset application to initial state before launching HPX app
steps: [Step 1] Initialize the test environment and ensure clean state
[Step 2] Invoke the reset_app() method from the flow controller
[Step 3] Verify application returns to initial state successfully

intermediary_steps.test_case_step: Add printer device (precondition) via Add Device button and search by IP address
steps: [Step 1] Navigate to the printer management section on root view
[Step 2] Locate and click the 'Add Device' button
[Step 4] Input the printer IP address from test configuration
[Step 5] Execute search and verify printer is discovered and added successfully

intermediary_steps.test_case_step: Verify shortcuts screen is displayed after navigation
steps: [Step 1] Retrieve the shortcuts screen title element
[Step 2] Verify the title matches expected shortcuts screen identifier
[Step 3] Assert validation passes confirming shortcuts screen is displayed

intermediary_steps.test_case_step: Verify add new shortcut screen is displayed after clicking Add New Shortcut button
steps: [Step 1] Retrieve the add new shortcut screen title element
[Step 2] Verify the title matches expected add new shortcut screen identifier
[Step 3] Assert validation passes confirming add new shortcut screen is displayed

automation_scripts_rules.description: Explicitly document implicit steps in the test case for traceability (reset app, printer addition, screen verifications)
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case contains implicit steps required for execution
THEN: Document these steps explicitly in the automation mapping for traceability
IMPLEMENTATION: Include reset app, printer addition, and screen verification steps as explicit intermediary steps

automation_scripts_rules.description: Ensure all supporting validation steps (screen title assertions) are included in automation scripts for early failure detection
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All navigation and screen transition steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Navigating between screens or views
THEN: Assert screen title and main UI elements are visible and correctly rendered
IMPLEMENTATION: Add assertion steps after each navigation to verify screen title and UI elements

automation_scripts_rules.description: Maintain strict sequential execution order and intermediary step granularity in automation implementation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script steps within a test case
rule_definition: WHEN: Multiple steps exist in automation script
THEN: Execute in strict sequential order and maintain intermediary step granularity
IMPLEMENTATION: Follow execution order and ensure intermediary steps are detailed for each script line

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implement platform-specific reset commands for Android and iOS to ensure application returns to default state
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases requiring application reset (C46 and similar)
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case requires resetting HPX application to default state
THEN: Execute platform-specific reset command based on target platform
IMPLEMENTATION: For Android use 'adb shell pm clear com.hpx.application', for iOS use launch with '--reset-to-defaults' argument, and verify no devices or shortcuts exist post-reset

automation_scripts_rules.description: Verify all main UI elements are visible and enabled after each navigation point for comprehensive screen validation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All navigation steps in test cases (HPX Home, Device Details, Shortcuts, Add New Shortcuts screens)
rule_definition: WHEN: Navigation to a new screen occurs (launch, device details, shortcuts, add new shortcuts)
THEN: Assert screen title matches expected value AND verify all main UI elements are visible and enabled

IMPLEMENTATION: After navigation, verify elements including Add Device button, navigation bar, device list container, settings icon, back button, input fields, action buttons, and section headers are visible/enabled

automation_scripts_rules.description: Validate all preconditions in automation setup phase and reference them explicitly in test case steps
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases with preconditions (printer addition, user login)
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case has preconditions such as supported printer added or user logged in
THEN: Implement precondition validation checks in automation setup phase
IMPLEMENTATION: Add explicit precondition validation steps in automation framework setup, verify printer presence on root view after addition, and confirm user login state before test execution

automation_scripts_rules.description: Break down high-level test steps into atomic actions with explicit verifications for improved automation readiness
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test case steps requiring granularity improvement
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case contains high-level steps with implicit actions
THEN: Decompose into atomic actions with explicit verifications for each action

IMPLEMENTATION: Transform high-level steps into explicit reset step, explicit navigation with assertions, explicit documentation of implicit actions, enabling direct mapping to automation framework methods

automation_scripts_rules.description: Ensure traceability and auditability by explicitly listing all implicit steps in test case documentation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases with implicit steps (reset, printer addition, screen verifications)
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case execution relies on implicit steps not documented in test case
THEN: Explicitly list all implicit steps in test case documentation for traceability

IMPLEMENTATION: Document implicit steps including resetting application state before launching, verifying printer presence on root view after addition, and screen title/UI element assertions after each navigation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Map explicit reset step to automation framework setup phase for reliability and consistency
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases requiring application reset (C46 and similar)
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case requires explicit reset of HPX application to default state
THEN: Map reset step to automation framework setup phase
IMPLEMENTATION: Include reset step in both intermediate and automated scripts, execute in setup phase before test execution, and verify application state post-reset

automation_scripts_rules.description: Enforce comprehensive UI element verification including visibility and enabled state for all interactive elements
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All screen validation steps after navigation
rule_definition: WHEN: Screen validation is required after navigation
THEN: Verify both visibility AND enabled state of all interactive UI elements

IMPLEMENTATION: For each screen, assert visibility and enabled state of buttons (Add Device, Back, action buttons), navigation elements (navigation bar), containers (device list), icons (settings), input fields, and section headers
